name: Focus
description: A Pomodoro timer: 25 minutes on, 5 off. She keeps quiet about the timer while you focus and tells you when to stretch.
author: The Sara team

settings.label: Minutes of focus
settings.tip: How long one focus block lasts. 25 is the classic Pomodoro; try 50 for deep work.

settings.label: Minutes of break
settings.tip: How long the break after each block lasts. Stand up, stretch, look away from the screen.
